---

## 2. Services

| Service | Scope |
| :--- | :--- |
| Sheet metal laser cutting | Carbon steel, stainless and aluminium sheet; material in stock for fast production starts |
| Sheet metal bending | CNC press brake bending, from thin gauge sheet to structural components |
| Manual welding | MIG/MAG and TIG welding of steel, stainless and aluminium; structural and cosmetic welds |
| Robotic welding | Robotic welding for production series — consistent welds, shorter cycle times |
| CNC milling | Machine components and precision parts, including post-processing of laser-cut and welded parts |
| CNC turning | Bushings, shafts, flanges and fasteners to the accuracy classes on the drawing |
| CNC tube bending | Frames, handrails, spatial structures and piping components |
| CNC profile cutting | Profiles, tubes and sections cut to length and angle for welded structures and machine frames |
| Mechanical assembly | Sub-units and complete units from own and customer-supplied parts, delivered tested |
| Electrical assembly | From simple harnesses to complete cabinets and modules |
| CAD/CAM engineering | Documentation for manufacture, sheet metal unfolds, CAM programs, material advice |
| General metalwork | Drilling, tapping, grinding and finishing of parts |

**Not offered**: powder coating or other coating services.

| Machine | Type | Capacity |

Parts outside these ranges: send the documentation and Precimet will confirm feasibility after reviewing it.

---

## 4. Order process

1. **Inquiry** — send a drawing, 3D model or part description with material, quantity and target date.
2. **Inquiry review** — a process engineer checks the documentation and feasibility, selects the manufacturing technology and raises questions or optimisation proposals.
3. **Quotation** — usually within 1–2 business days, stating scope, price, lead time and terms.
4. **Production** — starts once the quote is accepted, to the documentation and agreed technology.
5. **Quality control** — under ISO 9001:2015 procedures; agreed quality documentation and material certificates on request.
6. **Delivery** — parts are packed securely and delivered to the address given, in Poland and Europe.

---

## 5. When to use Precimet

**Good fit**
- Metal parts or assemblies made to drawing — from one-off prototypes to repeatable series, with no minimum order quantity.
- Several processes from one supplier: cutting, bending, welding, machining and assembly.
- Machine and equipment building, automation and robotics, food, energy, transport and logistics, construction and infrastructure, metal furniture and fit-out, agriculture.

**Not a fit**
- Coating-only work (e.g. powder coating).
- Consumer or retail requests.
- Plastic parts (injection moulding, plastic 3D printing), woodworking, glass or casting.
